title: The Sixth-Bowler Insurance Policy: How Much Flexibility Does Kolkata Knight Riders Need?
dek: How much flexibility do Kolkata Knight Riders need from a sixth bowling option? Workload and economy beyond the core five measure the insurance policy's cost.
excerpt: Kolkata Knight Riders have used six or more bowlers in {{ev:sb-tused}} of their bowling innings since 2022. League-wide, overs from beyond the core five have cost more than the core's.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: The Insurance Question
body: A sixth bowling option is insurance: if a frontline bowler is being hit, or injured, someone else can take the overs. The premium is paid in batting depth, because the sixth bowler usually displaces a specialist batter.
Since 2022 Kolkata Knight Riders have used six or more bowlers in {{ev:sb-tused}} of their bowling innings, against {{ev:sb-lused}} for the rest of the league.

sections.heading: What the Extra Overs Cost
body: Across the rest of the IPL, the five bowlers who bowl most in each innings conceded {{ev:sb-lcore}} an over; everyone else conceded {{ev:sb-lextra}}.
For KKR, bowlers beyond the core five conceded {{ev:sb-textra}} an over and bowled {{ev:sb-tshare}} of the side's balls.

sections.heading: Designing the Policy
body: The right amount of insurance depends on how reliable the core five are. A side with five frontline bowlers who rarely go for big overs needs little cover; a side with a volatile bowler needs a sixth option in every match.
For KKR, an all-rounder whose bowling is close to frontline standard is worth more than a part-timer who only bowls in emergencies.

sections.heading: The Impact-Player Complication
body: Since 2023 the impact-player rule lets sides add a bowler or a batter during the match, which changes the value of a sixth option in the starting eleven. The pre-2023 and post-2023 numbers are not strictly comparable.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Buy the Policy Only If the Core Is Volatile
body: League-wide, overs beyond the core five have cost more than the core's. Kolkata Knight Riders should carry a sixth bowler when a frontline bowler's form is uncertain, not as a default.
Tracking how often the sixth option is actually used would show whether the policy is paying out.
